messages.author: 2bd5727c83eb63ab
messages.subject: Shinyapps ERROR 'Object not found'
parts:
Hi,

I've just created my first shinyapp. Locally the app runs just fine, however when I deploy it to shinyapps.io I get and ERROR object ... not found. The object in question is a character vector (rwanda_districts) which is used for 'choices' in my selectInput drop down box. The vector is saved in my Rdata file which is loaded in my server.R script. I'm not sure why this vector can't be found, but I'm sure there is a simple explanation. Anybody got any ideas?

Thanks in advance.

Marty
